subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Wise Old Man
description: A quick, practical guide to The Wise Old Man.

hook.text: Gandalf, Obi-Wan, Dumbledore. The wise guide appears in every era's stories. Jung explains why.

buildup.text: The Wise Old Man archetype represents knowledge, guidance, and authority earned through suffering.

discovery.text: Odin sacrificed an eye for wisdom. Tiresias was blind but saw truth. The price of sight is loss.

twist.text: This archetype can mislead. False gurus exploit the pattern. The wise figure can be a trap.

climax.text: Jung said we project this archetype onto leaders. Understanding it protects us from blind trust.

punchline.text: Wisdom wears many masks. Some lie.

quiz.question: What did Odin sacrifice for wisdom?
